title: Shadows, outlines, and focus rings
learningObjectives: Explain shadows, outlines, and focus rings and use visual effects responsibly.

understand.concept: box-shadow and text-shadow create decorative depth; outline draws a line outside an element's border without taking up layout space. Focus rings should remain clearly visible and should not be replaced by subtle decorative shadows.
understand.whyItMatters: A focus ring is an accessibility indicator, not just decoration. Ensure sufficient contrast in all themes and avoid clipping it inside overflow-hidden containers.
understand.analogy: A shadow suggests depth; an outline marks a boundary; a focus ring identifies the current keyboard target.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy is simplified; CSS compositing and animation timelines follow browser rendering rules.

explain.narrative: The button has a subtle shadow, while keyboard focus receives a stronger outline that is not dependent on the shadow.

examples.explanation: The button has a subtle shadow, while keyboard focus receives a stronger outline that is not dependent on the shadow.
examples.expectedOutput: A rendered example demonstrating the visual effect or animation behaviour.

practise.guidedTask: Design a button with a subtle shadow and a high-contrast focus ring. Test it against both light and dark backgrounds.
practise.independentTask: Build a visual component using the effect. Include a fallback, check contrast, and test keyboard and reduced-motion behaviour where relevant.
hints: Keep essential content independent of visual effects.
Check browser support and fallback behaviour.

practice.starterCode:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>Shadows, outlines, and focus rings</title></head><body>
<button class='action'>Save changes</button><style>.action{padding:.8rem 1rem;border:1px solid #456;border-radius:.5rem;box-shadow:0 2px 5px rgb(0 0 0 / 12%)}.action:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #b42318;outline-offset:3px}</style>
</body></html>
practice.resetCode:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>Shadows, outlines, and focus rings</title></head><body>
<button class='action'>Save changes</button><style>.action{padding:.8rem 1rem;border:1px solid #456;border-radius:.5rem;box-shadow:0 2px 5px rgb(0 0 0 / 12%)}.action:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #b42318;outline-offset:3px}</style>
</body></html>

questions.prompt: Which property is suitable for a visible focus ring without changing layout dimensions?
questions.explanation: outline is drawn outside the border and does not occupy layout space.

questions.prompt: What should accompany an advanced visual effect?
options: A readable fallback and accessible content
Essential meaning available only through the effect
An assumption that all browsers support it
questions.answer: A readable fallback and accessible content
questions.explanation: Progressive enhancement keeps the interface usable when effects are unsupported or disabled.
